scripts.title: Best Cafe in Kharagpur
scripts.scriptText:
Guys, today I found one of the best cafes in Kharagpur and I couldn't wait to tell you about it! 🔥

It's called Brew & Bites and let me tell you — the vibe is absolutely immaculate. Cozy seating, fairy lights, and that smell of freshly brewed coffee the moment you walk in.

They have an amazing cold brew and these absolutely insane croissants that you just have to try. The price is super reasonable too — a full breakfast under ₹200.

If you're a student here or just visiting Kharagpur, this place is a must-visit. Link in bio for the location!

#KharagpurCafe #BrewAndBites #KGPLife #CafeKharagpur

scripts.title: New Burger Launch at City Square
scripts.scriptText:
If you're a burger lover in Kharagpur, you CANNOT miss this! 🍔

City Square just dropped their new Smoky BBQ Loaded Burger and I was literally shaking after the first bite. Double patty, smoked bacon, crispy onion rings, and their secret sauce — all for just ₹249.

They're running a launch offer too — buy one get one free on weekends only. I'd say get there before the crowd figures this out.

Comment 'BURGER' below if you want the full address and timing!

#KharagpurFood #BurgerKharagpur #CitySquare #FoodReel

scripts.title: Hidden Highway Dhaba Near IIT Kharagpur
scripts.scriptText:
Save this Reel right now because this hidden dhaba serves the best Tadka and Butter Naan in all of Kharagpur! 🥘

Located just 4km from IIT Main Gate on the bypass road, Sharma Punjabi Dhaba has been quietly feeding truckers and students for 15 years.

Must-order items:
1. Dal Tadka with double butter
2. Kadhai Paneer (super smoky!)
3. Tandoori Roti with fresh churned white butter

Total bill for two? Just ₹280. Share this with your hostel gang!

#IITKharagpur #KharagpurEats #DhabaFood #HighwayEats

scripts.title: Top 3 Sunset Spots in Kharagpur
scripts.scriptText:
Looking for peaceful spots to catch the sunset this weekend? Here are the top 3 spots in Kharagpur you probably didn't know about: 🌅

1. Hijli Forest Watch Tower — untouched nature and bird chirping
2. Kansai River Banks — golden hour reflections on the water
3. Nehru Museum Back Lawns — heritage feel with wide open skies
